title: Claude Cowork pricing: plans, limits and the rename
h1: claude cowork pricing: what are you paying for?
description: Compare Claude Free, Pro, Max and Ultra prices, see where Cowork is included, and separate the plan price from usage and other services.
answer: **cowork comes with paid claude plans; it isn't another add-on to buy.** as of 12 november 2026, monthly prices before tax are $20 for pro, $100 for max and $200 for ultra. free excludes cowork. anthropic now describes cowork and chat as one claude, so the older name may appear less often.[^1][^2][^3]

review.by: lead agent: independent reviewer pass against seo/facts (4 reviewers), every finding applied, automated gate

og_line: the plan price, the limits, the name.

table.h: claude consumer plans as of 12 november 2026
table.intro: **cowork has no separate add-on bill.** these are usd prices before tax, checked 12 november 2026. paid claude plans include it.[^1][^2]

sections.h: cowork is part of the claude plan
sections.md:
**start with the smallest paid plan that covers your work.** anthropic includes cowork on pro, max, ultra, team and enterprise. prices here are usd before tax, checked 12 november 2026.[^1][^2]

- pro: $20 with monthly billing
- pro annual: $200 up front, shown as $17/month
- max and ultra: monthly prices only
- team: $20 per seat/month annually, or $25 monthly
- enterprise: ask anthropic[^1][^2]

the annual pro price is a commitment, not a $17 monthly checkout. check the final checkout and current terms before paying.

sections.h: the rename does not create a second product bill
sections.md:
**keep using the access your paid plan already includes.** anthropic now describes cowork and chat as one claude. file work brings cowork in automatically.[^3]

older tutorials may show a separate tab or mac-only setup. compare their dates with your account before buying anything. the [platform guide](/guides/claude-cowork-windows) covers windows and linux too.

sections.h: the larger plan is about more than the sticker price
sections.md:
**buy more allowance only when allowance is the problem.** the current $200 tier is ultra, not the older max 20x name. max costs $100.[^2]

- max: 5x pro usage
- ultra: 10x pro weekly usage; no five-hour limit for verified accounts[^2]

those allowances don't promise unlimited work. first write down the task the smaller plan cannot finish. missing files or an unsuitable connection won't improve just because the plan costs more.

**your scheduled job can run while the laptop sleeps.** cowork includes remote scheduled tasks on all paid plans, using your allowance.[^6]

claude code has separate cloud scheduled tasks, formerly routines. they use plan allowance on pro, max, ultra, team and enterprise, with a minimum cloud interval of one hour. anthropic hosts them.[^4]

read the [claude code scheduling guide](/guides/claude-code-routines) for code work. choose the task type you need before paying.

sections.h: compare the costs of the workflow you want
sections.md:
**add the bills before comparing the price.** list the ai plan, extra services and where the work runs. in dusk, your ai provider bills usage separately from dusk.[^5]

dusk's desktop app is free for personal use. company work needs a work license, and dusk cloud has its own price.[^5]

the [cowork alternative guide](/alternatives/claude-cowork) compares that setup. put every part you need in the budget.

faq.q: is claude cowork free or paid?
faq.a: **paid, with no separate cowork price.** anthropic includes it on pro, max, ultra, team and enterprise. free does not include it.[^1]

faq.q: is the $200 claude plan still max?
faq.a: **it is ultra on the current pricing page.** checked 12 november 2026: max costs $100 monthly and ultra costs $200, before tax.[^2]

faq.q: do i pay extra because cowork is becoming claude?
faq.a: **the new name adds no separate cowork charge.** anthropic describes cowork and chat as one claude; access remains through paid plans.[^1][^3]

steps: open your account and find your current claude plan
identify the task that hits its limit
compare monthly billing with the annual commitment
read the current checkout total before upgrading

rows: max and ultra allowances, not just their names

mistakes.mistake: looking for a separate cowork add-on
mistakes.fix: paid claude plans include it. open your existing plan before buying.
that is the listed annual equivalent. pro takes $200 up front on that option.

mistakes.mistake: upgrading to fix a missing source file
mistakes.fix: give the task its inputs first. extra usage cannot replace missing evidence.

tip.text: write down what stopped your last task. upgrade for that constraint, not the biggest plan name.
